The page-copy items they wanted first, older guests' access and deposits if a supplier cancels, already sit before the primary. The rest are business details that brand-facts lists as deferred, logged in open_questions for /wonderland-concierge or later content. A Greece budget question checklist would suit this reader better as a magnet; it does not exist, so it is suggested, not placed.
